units.source_text: 此言太无礼了，如此存心，何其浅薄耶！”

en.t: Those words are far too rude; to think in such a way shows such shallowness!

units.source_text: 夕雾觉得诚然，付之一笑。

en.t: Yugiri felt that this was true, and dismissed it with a smile.

units.source_text: 后来听见老夫人正在膝行而出，便整整衣冠，与她相见。

en.t: Later, hearing that the old lady was shuffling out on her knees, he straightened his robes and met with her.

units.source_text: 老夫人开言道：“恐是在这辛酸的世间忧伤地度送日月之故吧，

en.t: The old lady began, "Perhaps it is because I have been passing my days in sorrow in this bitter world,

units.source_text: 心情异常苦闷，生涯茫然如梦。

en.t: but my heart is unbearably distressed, and my life feels vague and dreamlike.

units.source_text: 屡次劳驾慰问，实在不胜感谢，只得强起迎候。”

en.t: I am deeply grateful that you have troubled yourself to inquire after us so often, and so I forced myself to rise and receive you."

units.source_text: 看她的神情非常痛苦。

en.t: Her expression looked extremely pained.

units.source_text: 夕雾答道：“忧伤是难怪的，然而只管忧伤，也是枉然。

en.t: Yugiri replied, "It is only natural to grieve, but to do nothing but grieve is also useless.

units.source_text: 世间万事，皆前生注定，忧伤毕竟也有限度。”

en.t: All things in this world are fixed by former lives, and even sorrow must have its limits in the end."

units.source_text: 他用这话安慰她，心中想道：“尝闻人言，这位公主性情十分优雅。

en.t: He comforted her with these words, while thinking to himself, "I have often heard people say that this princess has a very graceful nature.

units.source_text: 如今惨遭不幸，生受世人讥笑，定然异常悲伤。”

en.t: Now that she has suffered such misfortune and must endure the ridicule of others, she must surely be terribly sad."

units.source_text: 情不自禁，便热心地探询公主的近况。

en.t: Unable to restrain himself, he earnestly asked about the princess's present condition.

units.source_text: 又想：“这位公主的相貌虽然不是十全其美，

en.t: He also thought, "Although this princess's looks may not be entirely perfect,

units.source_text: 但是只要不是十分面目可憎，

en.t: as long as she is not utterly repellent in appearance,

units.source_text: 难道可以凭外貌印象而嫌恶她，或者另外迷醉于荒谬的恋情么？

en.t: could one really despise her merely because of an impression of her looks, or lose oneself instead in some foolish love affair?

units.source_text: 这样做实在是可耻的。

en.t: To do that would truly be shameful.

units.source_text: 归根到底，一个人只有性情是最重要的。”

en.t: In the end, a person's character is what matters most."

units.source_text: 便又对老夫人说道：“今后但愿将小生当作故友一样看待，

en.t: Then he said again to the old lady, "From now on, I hope you will regard me as an old friend,

units.source_text: 请勿见外为幸。”

en.t: and I would be grateful if you would not treat me as a stranger."

units.source_text: 这话虽然不曾有意表示求爱，却已恳切地吐露他的心事了。

en.t: Though these words were not intentionally a declaration of love, they had already sincerely revealed what was in his heart.

units.source_text: 夕雾身穿常礼服，姿态异常鲜丽，长身玉立，相貌堂堂。

en.t: Yugiri wore his ordinary formal robes; his bearing was strikingly handsome, his tall figure stood gracefully, and his features were dignified.

units.source_text: 众侍女悄悄地议论：“他父亲万般和蔼可亲，

en.t: The ladies-in-waiting whispered among themselves, "His father is gentle and approachable in every way,

units.source_text: 其气品之高雅与态度之温柔，无人可与并比。

en.t: and no one can compare with his noble refinement and tender manner.

units.source_text: 这位公子则雄赳赳地，气宇轩昂，

en.t: This young gentleman, by contrast, is bold and splendid, with an imposing presence,

units.source_text: 令人一见便会惊叹：‘啊，好漂亮！’

en.t: so that anyone who sees him at once exclaims, 'Ah, how beautiful!'

units.source_text: 这相貌真是与众不同。”

en.t: His appearance is truly unlike anyone else's."

units.source_text: 接着又说：“索性让他就在这里进进出出吧。”

en.t: Then they added, "We might as well have him come and go here freely."
